goal: Consolidate the corrected-axis cut and two HD mouth-volume studies with explicit rejection evidence
steps: Bind the separated lower region to Bone02
Add palate, tongue and fang geometry in two distinct studies
Reject visible protrusions and unresolved lip/cheek topology
observations: Attempt03's script documented a z=119 lip cut, but its plane point/normal actually cut y=-119, outside the head region. This invalidates its claimed planar-cut conclusion.
The corrected z=120 cut opens the mouth but creates an unnaturally flat jagged lip and an exposed cheek hinge; it is rejected as production topology.
Mouth-volume study 01 shows palate and teeth protruding over the snout; study 02 tucks the palate inward but retains penetrating fangs and an unconnected lip border.
Procedural inner tubes are useful as anatomical placement guides, not a substitute for retopologized upper/lower lip loops and volumetric cheek tissue.

checks.name: correct-axis lip and hinge production quality
